items.context: @AdamBLiv (Adam Livingston, 89.273 seguidores): "Bitcoin just closed a week below its 200-week moving average again. From 2015 to 2023, it did this 7 times. Median return after each break: 6 months +80% (higher 6 of 7), 12 months +155% (7 of 7), 18 months +290%, 24 months +337%." Post de minutos con 11 likes, 929 vistas y aún sin respuestas. Ángulo: media de 200 semanas y temperatura de mercado.
items.suggested_text:
Seven breaks is a strong record but a small sample, and the path between the break and those 12-24 month numbers was rarely clean. In 2022 price lost the 200-week average in June, spent months under it and still set a lower low in November before the trend turned.

That's why I don't read the 200W on its own. My Market Temperature index gives it 25%, next to MVRV, the drawdown from the ATH and volatility-adjusted 90-day momentum. Over 364 days it went from 99.29 to 0.67: https://x.com/ForecastQuant/status/2122727211610542288

The base rates lean one way. What they can't tell you is how long the time under the line lasts this round.
